title: Check your data is ready for AI
summary: AI is only as good as the data behind it. Check you have the right data, of good enough quality, and that you are allowed to use it.

beginner: List the data the AI will need, for training, examples or retrieval.
Find where it lives and who owns it.
Check quality: is it complete, accurate, up to date and representative of all your users?
Check you have the legal right and consent to use it this way.
Plan how you will fill any gaps.
intermediate: Confirm legal basis and plan gaps.
experienced: Design a data strategy that improves as the product is used.
Plan data governance and retention for AI use.
Assess the risk of sensitive data leaking through outputs.

toolExamples.looker: Profile the data to see gaps and distributions.
toolExamples.power-bi: Chart data completeness by source and user group.

pitfalls: Data that does not represent all users
